scope.interactionChannel: isolated initial product state and real macOS pointer input via cliclick

observations.name: Driver baseline
observations.detail: The Native dialog renders the Web-authority title, description, three-step track, selected Codex driver, two-column enabled and disabled driver grid, and footer controls.

observations.name: Driver to Identity
observations.detail: A real pointer selection of Next advances to Identity, marks Driver complete, and exposes Label and Instance ID fields plus Back and Next.

observations.name: Identity validation gate
observations.detail: A second real Next pointer input leaves the wizard on Identity and renders Instance ID is required instead of advancing with placeholder text.

observations.name: Close reverse state
observations.detail: The real close control dismisses the dialog and restores the Providers route without persisting a provider instance.

missingCoverage: Native composed Identity input, Config, Add instance mutation, card projection, and Delete reverse mutation remain unverified.
Light-theme Native wizard was not captured.
classification.harnessLoss: One mis-scaled coordinate produced a transient diagnostic frame and was excluded. Desktop DevTool registration remains unavailable.
acceptedRenderingNoise: Native font shaping and system-host shadow rasterization differ from Browser pixels while preserving the shared hierarchy.
